name: Evil Corp
description: Evil Corp is a Russian cybercriminal organization led by Maksim 'Aqua' Yakubets, who the U.S. Justice Department indicted in 2019 with a $5 million bounty — the largest-ever for a cybercriminal. Active since at least 2009, the group deployed JabberZeus and Dridex banking malware to steal approximately $100 million from hundreds of businesses in the US and Europe. Yakubets also worked for the Russian FSB intelligence service from 2017, exemplifying Russia's use of cybercriminals as state contractors.
